label: D1 after a2 led to S1 (rare transition from a2)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (no GO/D2 activity), almost exclusively on trials where the agent goes on to choose a2 (99.7% of mass; policy logit moderately favours a2, choice in [-8.9,-1.5]; value low-to-mid, never above ~7.7). The strongest observed correlate is that the previous trial was a2 with a rare transition to S1 (prev_common==0 carries 73% of mass, lift 2.8x). Top windows are runs of a2->S1 rare trials where activation grows across the run, peaking at the D1 after the next a2->S2 outcome. Adding the upcoming choice (action==2, FUTURE but agent-computed) barely helps (dev F1 0.55 vs 0.53), so the observed-only predicate is recorded. Misses (~27% of mass) are mostly D1s after a2->S2 common trials within an a2-run, often unrewarded. Rate rises strongly with episode trial (near zero before trial 10, highest after 60). Silent on a1 trials and on any D1 where a1 will be chosen.
